summary: Avens was a male Nomai from Brittle Hollow, brother of Daz and husband of Mallow. He proposed the Orbital Probe Cannon, co-built it with Cassava, and pushed launch power past safe limits with Mallow, causing the cannon to break apart on its first real fire.

behavior: Avens believed finding the Eye of the Universe was worth significant risk.
Avens consistently pushed for the maximum possible launch power on the Orbital Probe Cannon.
Avens was confident his friends had accounted for his and Mallow's nature in their power limits and used that as a reason to exceed them anyway.
Avens and Mallow were a famously affectionate couple, prompting Cassava's wry jokes.
location: Avens originally came from Brittle Hollow.
Avens relocated to the Construction Yard on Giant's Deep to build the Orbital Probe Cannon.
Avens's remains are most likely with Mallow's at the Construction Yard.
lore: Avens was a member of the Nomai and of the Ash Twin Project team.
Avens was the brother of Daz.
Avens was the husband of Mallow.
Avens hypothesized the Eye of the Universe had stopped emitting its signal.
Avens proposed building a probe-launching cannon in orbit around a celestial body to circumvent the need to escape gravity.
Avens accepted Cassava's suggestion that the cannon should orbit Giant's Deep because it offered the best launch angles and was moonless except for visits from the Quantum Moon.
Avens and Mallow tested the cannon and adjusted its launch power.
Cassava and Daz set Avens and Mallow's maximum power setting slightly below the absolute structural maximum to leave room for their enthusiasm.
Avens and Mallow joined Cassava and Daz at the Construction Yard after the Orbital Probe Cannon was put on indefinite hold.
Avens and Mallow's power adjustment was eventually catastrophic for the Orbital Probe Cannon.
The Orbital Probe Cannon now breaks apart immediately upon firing each loop due to that power adjustment.
The Probe Tracking Module fell into Giant's Deep's ocean core after the cannon broke apart.
